helpful: Full-text petition and BIO were the decisive inputs; the BIO's no-split and vehicle arguments could not have been assessed from the docket alone.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached rates gave a directly usable anchor for a CVSG'd high-band petition.
context.json's cvsg_date and distribution_count made the increment claims unambiguous.
gaps: No corpus filter for 'CVSG issued' or for a statute/subject, so the corpus query could not surface comparable CVSG'd private petitions; the CVSG-conditioned base rate had to come from the statpack cut alone.
A cut of CVSG'd petitions by SG recommendation (grant vs deny) and the resulting grant rate would sharpen this kind of cell considerably.
The citation filter is nearly empty on scotus rows, so the two earlier Teck denials in this same litigation could not be pulled as priors.
notes: The cell was provisioned on the same day the CVSG order issued, so this distribution-moment cell is effectively a CVSG-conditioned forecast; the band already reflects it.
